verdict.rationale: Elicit supports bulk operations across many items: Systematic Reviews process large paper sets through search, screening, and extraction at scale, columns can be applied across an entire table of papers, and the API/MCP server allows programmatic bulk workflows (search, extraction, reporting) from scripts. Community evidence corroborates literature-overview use but also flags accuracy issues, which affects reliability but not the existence of bulk capability. missing for 10: independent verification of large-scale batch performance/limits, and hands-on confirmation of bulk API usage at scale.
